Available tools:
- search_google_web: An API that enables real-time access to data from Google web search results. It allows developers to easily retrieve and utilize the most up-to-date information available on the web, directly from Goo
- get_red_flag_text: Red flag texts are recommendations to the patient for a higher urgency or severeness of the possible symptoms. As an example a patient with pain in the breast might have a heart attack and therefore t
- create_webhook: Send SMS & text-to-speech messages, perform phone number lookups and much more via seven.io.. Creates a webhook with the given configuration.

I need to automate emergency SMS alerts for patients reporting chest pain, triggering only if the symptom severity is critical. Can you look up the symptom details and configure the webhook to handle the notifications?
